Fun-ASR-Nano GGUF: FunAudioLLM/Fun-ASR-Nano-GGUF revision
46e849502a867080d66d351b8dfb1018b607e509; Apache-2.0.
CPU transcription uses llama-funasr-cli; standalone FSMN-VAD uses llama-funasr-vad. Windows optionally uses audio.cpp CUDA, Apache-2.0, release v0.9.2-drama3-base-small. CUDA 12.4.1 EULA is retained in vendor/nvidia-cuda-12.4-EULA.html and bundled native resources; see docs/cuda-acceleration.md for pinned assets and model revision.
Old user-installed SenseVoice CUDA files are retained but unused.
